dice: Only d6s. 3d6 for ability tests; one die is a different color: the Dragon Die.
The Dragon Die is used for degrees of success, tie-breaks and stunt points.

abilityTest.formula: 3d6 + ability + focus (+2). Only one focus can apply to a test.
notation: Ability (Focus required): without the focus you automatically fail.
abilityTest.opposed: Both roll; higher result wins. Tie: higher Dragon Die. Still tied: higher ability. With more than two, highest wins (same tiebreak).
abilityTest.degreesOfSuccess: Only on success. Read the Dragon Die; at level 6+ you may add the test's focus bonus to the Dragon Die. 1 = barely, 6+ = spectacular.
abilityTest.reaction: Resisting something (a spell, being pushed) is a reaction test on someone else's turn and takes no time.
abilityTest.stacking: Different effects stack. Multiple instances of the same talent/power/spell do not stack unless stated.

advancedNote: Repeated tests accumulate toward a success threshold; the first to meet it wins. Thresholds above 25 are discouraged.
stuntRules: Generated when you roll doubles on an attack roll (that hits) or on certain tests. SP = Dragon Die value. Use them immediately.
Each stunt can be performed once per round, except Skirmish.
Class powers can reduce the cost of some stunts.
There are also spell stunts and exploration/roleplaying stunts.
Lightning Attack's second attack never generates more SP.

combatStunts.name: Skirmish
combatStunts.effect: Move yourself or the target 2 yards in any direction per 1 SP. May be used repeatedly.

combatStunts.name: Stay Aware
combatStunts.effect: TN 11 Perception test (any focus). Success: GM shows you something you missed, or +1 to your next test (doesn't stack with other bonuses except focus; expires at end of your next turn).

combatStunts.name: Knock Prone
combatStunts.effect: Target falls prone. Melee attacks vs prone get +1. Prone can't Run, needs a Move action to stand.

combatStunts.name: Defensive Stance
combatStunts.effect: +2 Defense until the start of your next turn.

combatStunts.name: Disarm
combatStunts.effect: Opposed attack rolls (no SP). Win: weapon flies 1d6 + Strength yards.

combatStunts.name: Pierce Armor
combatStunts.effect: Target's armor rating halved (round down) vs this attack.

combatStunts.name: Taunt
combatStunts.effect: Opposed Communication (Deception) vs Willpower (Self-Discipline), target within 10 yd. Win: -1 to attack and casting rolls on its next turn.

combatStunts.name: Threaten
combatStunts.effect: Opposed Strength (Intimidation) vs Willpower (Self-Discipline), target within 10 yd. Win: it must attack you on its next turn.

combatStunts.name: Lightning Attack
combatStunts.effect: Second attack on same or other enemy in range/sight (needs loaded missile weapon for ranged).

combatStunts.name: Dual Strike
combatStunts.effect: Apply the same attack roll to a second target (adjacent for melee, within 6 yd of primary for missile). Hit: normal damage.

combatStunts.name: Seize the Initiative
combatStunts.effect: Move to top of initiative order until someone else seizes it.

text: Narrative time is loose. Action time starts with 'Roll for initiative'. A round = 15 seconds (4 per minute).

Initiative: Dexterity (Initiative) test; major NPCs individually, minor NPCs as groups. Order is fixed for the encounter; newcomers roll at the start of the round they appear. Ties: Dragon Die, then higher ability.
On your turn: one major action + one minor action, or two minor actions (any order; fewer is OK). Free actions don't count.

majorActions.name: All-Out Attack
majorActions.effect: Melee vs adjacent. +1 damage on a hit; -1 Defense until your next turn (hit or miss).

majorActions.name: Charge
majorActions.effect: Move up to half Speed (round down), then melee attack with +1 attack.

majorActions.name: Defend
majorActions.effect: +2 Defense until the start of your next turn.

majorActions.name: Heal
majorActions.effect: Adjacent ally, needs bandages. TN 11 Cunning (Healing). Success: ally regains Dragon Die + your Cunning Health. Can't benefit again until damaged again.

majorActions.name: Melee Attack
majorActions.effect: Attack an adjacent enemy (within 2 yards counts as adjacent).

majorActions.name: Ranged Attack
majorActions.effect: Fire/throw at a visible enemy in range.

majorActions.name: Run
majorActions.effect: Move up to double Speed. Not allowed when prone.

minorActions.name: Activate
minorActions.effect: Start using a power or item (fighting style, potion...).

minorActions.name: Aim
minorActions.effect: +1 to the attack roll of your next melee/ranged attack.

minorActions.name: Guard Up
minorActions.effect: +1 or +2 Defense until end of round, but same penalty to all your tests (even opposed) for the rest of the round. Must be done before any major action this turn.

minorActions.name: Move
minorActions.effect: Up to Speed in yards. Going prone, standing, or mounting = half Speed (round down).

minorActions.name: Prepare
minorActions.effect: Choose a major action to execute as an interrupt before your next turn; end your turn. Can't use if you already took a major action.

minorActions.name: Press the Attack
minorActions.effect: Pursue an enemy you already struck this turn if it moves away: move up to Speed immediately after its movement.

minorActions.name: Stand Firm
minorActions.effect: Until your next turn, enemies using Skirmish/Knock Prone on you must win Strength (Might) vs your Strength (Might) or Dexterity (Acrobatics).

combat.attackRoll: Ability test based on weapon group + focus + modifiers. TN = target's Defense. Hit if result >= Defense.
combat.damage: Weapon damage + Strength (Bows add Perception instead of Strength) + modifiers - target's Armor Rating (skip subtraction for penetrating damage). Minimum 0.
dying: A PC at 0 Health is dying: dies at the start of their turn after 2 + Constitution rounds unless healed. Can talk, no other actions. Health never goes below 0.
Pulling a killing blow: attacker may leave target unconscious at 1 Health; wakes in 2d6 minutes.
Coup de grace: adjacent enemy, major action, automatic kill on dying/unconscious. Ranged: needs an attack roll vs Defense 10.
mounts: Mount as part of a Move action (half Speed). Then use the mount's Speed for move/run.
+1 melee attack vs foes on foot (GM may deny vs large monsters).
Enemies may attack you or the mount; track the mount's Health.
Knock Prone vs rider: Dexterity (Riding) TN 10 + attacker's Strength to stay mounted; fail: 1d6 penetrating damage and prone.
Vehicles: Strength (Driving). Passengers resist Knock Prone with Dexterity (Acrobatics).

attackModifiers.circumstance: Defender in heavy cover (building, stone wall); melee attacker in heavy snow
Defender in light cover (hedge, woods); melee attacker in mud; ranged attack vs defender engaged in melee; combat at night
Rain, mist or smoke obscures defender; low light
Attacker on higher ground; defender prone; melee attacker and allies outnumber defender 2:1

healing.amount: Dragon Die + healer's Cunning (once per damage event)

healing.method: Breather (5 min, once per encounter; not allowed if you ended combat at 0)

focuses.name: Enchantment
focuses.note: Only dwarves and Tranquil can enchant.
